name: Defense, Drones & Space (small-cap)
edge: The small-cap drone/space layer moves hard on contracts and conflict.

catalysts.title: Government contract award
catalysts.logic: A named contract award is a direct revenue signal for the awardee.

secondOrder.note: Conflict raises energy-security priority -> supportive for domestic nuclear fuel and enrichment.
Conflict near trade routes forces rerouting and adds a war-risk premium -> higher freight/tanker rates.
Conflict in a breadbasket/exporter region threatens grain and fertilizer supply -> higher prices.

catalysts.title: Launch success / failure
catalysts.logic: Success bullish, failure bearish - sentiment words decide.
